choices.content: Opposite sides are equal in length
The diagonals are equal in length

question.prompt: Which of the following properties does a rectangle have that a general parallelogram does not necessarily have?

solutions.explanation: Equal opposite sides, equal opposite angles, and diagonals that bisect each other are properties of all parallelograms. Equal diagonals are a special property of rectangles.
solutions.title: Comparing rectangle and parallelogram properties
